chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha, from al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
The Ziyarah of the grave of my father is like the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn.

key_terms.قَبْرِ أَبِي: Grave of my father (referring to Imam Musa al-Kadhim)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of visiting the grave of Imam Musa al-Kadhim compared to Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) elevates the spiritual status of Imam Musa al-Kadhim’s (a.s.) shrine in Baghdad by equating its reward to that of the preeminent shrine of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) in Karbala. This comparison underscores the concept of 'Tawassul' through the Ahl al-Bayt, suggesting that devotion to the Imams is a unified path to divine proximity, regardless of geographical location. It also highlights the historical significance of the Hashimiyya shrine as a major center of Shia pilgrimage during the Abbasid era.
